To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the application of marketing human resource management policies vary significantly both between and within business strategy types and marketing strategy types.
the application of marketing specific HRM policies is positively associated with the implementation of business and marketing strategies.

Firms whose business strategy is Prospectors and whose marketing strategy is Aggressive Marketers have significantly stronger overall firm financial performance scores than those firms whose business strategy is Analyzers, Low cost Defenders or Differentiated Defenders and whose marketing strategy are Aggressive Marketers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the application of human resource policies in the marketing function, and how this application impacts business and marketing strategy fit.

the impact of human resource management (HRM) policies for marketing managers on business and marketing strategies and how these HRM policies influence the implementation of business and marketing strategies.
the application of human resource practices in marketing organizations and the impact of those practices on business and marketing strategies implementation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
firms pursuing a Prospector strategy and an Aggressive Marketing strategy have a significantly stronger HR policy alignment than other business and marketing strategy combinations.
the more a firm's HRM policies are tailored to its marketing strategy, the better its performance.

firms that are able to align their business and marketing strategies, by applying human resource management policies in a manner that is congruent with their strategy, achieve superior firm performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

firms whose business and marketing strategy are aligned and whose human resource management policies support those aligned strategies will achieve significantly better overall business performance than firms whose human resource management policy does not support the alignment of business and marketing strategy.

firms whose business and marketing strategy are aligned and have strong HR policies for marketing personnel will outperform firms whose business and market strategy do not align and have strong HR practices.
HR policies should be designed and applied to support the firm's business and marketing strategies.
The main takeaway from our work is that
firms that do not have a fit between their business strategy and their marketing strategy are less likely to implement the marketing strategies they have adopted.
firms should consider their HR policies when developing and implementing business and marketing strategies.
the application of human resource policies for mid level marketers is an important component in the successful implementation of business and marketing strategy.
